content: The standard full workflow of the autonomous-task-brain skill follows a fixed 5-step self-improving loop: Perceive (scan recent sessions/events for new/repeated/failed tasks) → Retrieve (search local skills, historical sessions, memory engines, GitHub for optimal solutions) → Decide (choose execute/suggest/skip action based on historical success rate, task complexity, user preferences) → Execute (create/modify skills, cron jobs, scripts, or delegate subtasks) → Review (record execution results, update knowledge base for future optimization).
